statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every integer v, v occurs in r if and only if both (there exists i with 0 <= i < len(nums1) and nums1[i] = v) and (there exists j with 0 <= j < len(nums2) and nums2[j] = v); moreover, r has no repeated entries: for every i and j with 0 <= i < len(r) and 0 <= j < len(r), if r[i] = r[j] then i = j.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums1) <= 1000, 1 <= len(nums2) <= 1000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), 0 <= nums1[i] <= 1000, and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), 0 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: The function returns a result r and does not fail.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums1) <= 1000, 1 <= len(nums2) <= 1000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), 0 <= nums1[i] <= 1000, and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), 0 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.
